title: Remove unsupported supplier-prepoured scope from the Wilkins-Chalgren proposal
body:
The unapplied W04 new-owner payload Oxoid_Wilkins_Chalgren_Agar_Plates.yaml asserts a supplier-prepared basal plate product across its material scope, supplied form and evidence. PMC3101863 reports growth on Oxoid Wilkins-Chalgren agar plates supplemented with blood and antibiotics. It does not establish that basal plates were purchased pre-poured or the order of plate preparation.

Exact reviewed scope:
- Finding `MEDIA-SCI-01`; stable key `w04-independent-MEDIA-SCI-01`; immutable peer review `20261108T070033Z-w04-successor-science-v1`.
- `I1201-MEDIA-P-oxoid_wilkins_chalgren_agar_plates`; owner `data/ingredients/mapped/Oxoid_Wilkins_Chalgren_Agar_Plates.yaml`; before `absent (new proposal; no maintained owner created)`; proposed SHA256 `0554c990d6eaacdc7dfef4977d87fbb138998dd93eeb0b6fd509d15b793adc11`.
  [Exact published proposal](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/548e7bdd0ce2a68b3ae0df6ad7a6150a4e5c9bb9/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-04/successors/issue-1201-v1/proposals/media/Oxoid_Wilkins_Chalgren_Agar_Plates.yaml).

Correct only the unsupported procurement/preparation claim in every affected field, including preferred material scope, supplied form, notes, mapping evidence, curation history and recipe reference. Represent the source-supported agar/plate preparation with honest supplements and remaining limitations. Do not infer the opposite purchase form from a current powder catalogue comparator or treat blood/antibiotics as part of an unqualified basal supplier product. Preserve the old payload/evidence as a historical draft and publish a fully bound successor.

Evidence:

- [Primary/ontology source](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3101863/); capture SHA256 `0d6b310e7e41ca1501369512ae6b0958becc068381fbd72dccaa4166fb78c04d`; Methods: Bacterial Growth Conditions
- [Primary/ontology source](https://www.thermofisher.com/order/catalog/product/CM0619B); capture SHA256 `4421686b2cbcab2344e98871108f7b71c26959c892fbfa7455212a106607e5a3`; ProductCM0619B current powder comparator, not historical procurement

Deduplication: Fresh all-state Wilkins search found no exact tracker. #1201 is related source-completion context; this dedicated finding concerns an affirmative unsupported new-payload claim.

Review context: W04 published head `548e7bdd0ce2a68b3ae0df6ad7a6150a4e5c9bb9`, frozen campaign base `e000d66dd26ab053e9b17ce7bf8d3c873c3dde99`. Main as observed at `0dac278466699129a083343a921c2e0ca18a9ab4` has the same eighteen affected inherited-owner blobs as the frozen baseline; this is not a report of already-applied campaign curation. The full independent assembly covers 188 source cases and 115 proposals and remains `needs_curation`. Original peer review and evidence are immutable. Agent-authored new mapping evidence must satisfy #1226 without relabeling historical human evidence. The fix must use existing native guarded proposal validation and independent re-review; it grants no maintained-owner or export approval and requires no new gate, threshold, or synonym-selection rule.
